what: Step D: DoubleEG trigger-matching efficiency, all files combined
regions_note: barrel |eta|<1.4442, gap 1.4442<=|eta|<=1.566, endcap 1.566<|eta|<2.5, on Electron_eta -- the variable the electron selection itself cuts on. Gap electrons DO pass the selection (no gap veto), so the gap is a separate third region and is never merged into either.

measurement_definitions.a_leading_tagged: num leading matched / den subleading matched
measurement_definitions.b_subleading_tagged: num subleading matched / den (leading matched AND leading pT>30)
measurement_definitions.c_leading_untagged: num leading matched / den all population events
measurement_definitions.d2_subleading_plain: num subleading matched / den all population events

criterion.rule: Delta_region = eff_sub(>30) - eff_sub(25-30) from measurement (b); <= 2.0 pp in BOTH barrel and endcap -> leading_only, else both
